game.q: the curse breaks. what does ahalya do first?
opts: finally sits down after all those years
welcomes the princes as honored guests
leaves the hermitage a one-star review

wrong.sit: earned, honestly. but no. she stood up and hosted.
wrong.stars: tempting. she went with grace instead.

game.right: YES. water, offerings, and flowers falling from the sky. the woman nobody could see became the host.

end.line: she waited years, still as stone. then one moment, and she stood up free.
end.l2: one moment, and she stood up free.

cliff.s1: next: a boy on a deadline.
cliff.s2: he was told he’d only live to sixteen. on his birthday, he held on.
cliff.tmr: tomorrow: the boy who wouldn’t let go.

share: years, still as stone. then footsteps. the ahalya story on infinite hill
